recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, high-energy ensemble collage featuring a diverse group of young adults in red athletic and cheerleading uniforms, framed within a large, stylized numeric graphic. The composition is set against a saturated orange gradient background with a prominent liquid splash element and a hand-sign icon.
coreVisualRelationships: Cast members are nested within the negative space of a large white-outlined numeral.
A bright green liquid splash breaks the frame from the top right.
The main title typography overlaps the top left corner of the central graphic.
High-contrast red uniforms pop against the warm orange background.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large numeral '5' dominates the center-right, acting as a window for the cast portraits. The title is positioned top-left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large white-outlined numeral '5' serves as the primary structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large title top-left, follow the curve of the '5' through the cast members, and end at the hand-sign icon at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The orange background provides significant negative space around the central graphic, with a drop shadow creating depth.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Neon Green (Liquid splash) and Crimson Red (Uniforms)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout with bright, even studio lighting on subjects.

letterConstructionRules: Lowercase emphasis for the main title
Thick white outlines around red-filled letters
Secondary text in clean, all-caps or lowercase sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'g' features a distinctive circular bowl and a descender that flows into the 'l'
The 'ee' characters are tightly packed and mirrored

composition.relationshipToImage: Overlays the background and partially the frame

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A bold, stylized display face paired with a clean, functional secondary sans-serif for metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and lowercase aesthetic.
Provides the necessary weight and geometric foundation.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a vibrant orange radial gradient background. In the center-right, place a large white-outlined numeral '5' acting as a window. Inside the window, composite a group of diverse teenagers in red football jerseys and cheerleading outfits, all smiling and cheering. Add a neon green liquid splash pouring from a red cooler at the top of the '5'. Add a red hand-sign icon at the bottom left of the '5'.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, red, lowercase display title in the top-left corner with a thick white outline and a soft drop shadow. Add secondary sans-serif text in white for volume and season details, ensuring they are placed in the negative space of the orange background.

verificationChecks: Is the numeral '5' the primary framing device?
Is the background a saturated orange gradient?
Are the uniforms primarily red and white?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the liquid splash looks dynamic and interacts with the frame.
Ensure the white outline on the typography is thick and consistent.
Verify that the cast members are well-integrated into the numeric frame.
Confirm the orange background has a noticeable radial gradient.
recipe.reuseFormula: Ensemble cast + Geometric numeric frame + Saturated gradient background + Bold outlined lowercase typography.
